text: That night: the baboon darts out of the laurel bushes
why: ¶222 describes a figure darting from a clump of laurel bushes during the night visit, and ¶225 identifies it as the baboon.

text: That night: Holmes murmurs that it is the baboon
why: ¶224-225 state that Holmes put his lips to Watson's ear and murmured, 'That is the baboon,' during that night's approach to the house.
